purpose: Complete commit coverage with risk-weighted review; no claim that the upstream audit has been executed.

review_rules.condition: Diff screening establishes no behavior, contract, security, regression-test signal or relevant build effect.
Only if no relevant dependencies, code generation, publishing, supply-chain or emitted-artifact effect; otherwise individual semantic/deep review.
Evidence shows the feature does not affect preserved or delegated behavior.

completion_requirements: Reconcile raw inventory against exact individual/batch SHA membership; no gaps or wildcard closure.
Expand/split batches when security, behavior or contract relevance is uncertain.
Prove inherited fixes are in exact selected peers per branch, not merely in the research head.
Close adaptation/test items only with implementation and test evidence.
Resolve sensitive pending items before declaring audit completion or affected release readiness.
